title: Binance Pay: Tourist Payment via QR Code Now Available in Vietnam!
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is now pleased to announce that  Binance Pay  is integrated with  QR solutions  to support  tourists’ payments  in  Vietnam . With this feature, tourists can scan supported merchants’ QR codes to pay directly using their crypto balance on Binance. Use crypto seamlessly with Binance Pay – spend with crypto at QR code-supported merchants when traveling in Vietnam, or send crypto to your friends and family worldwide! How to Use Tourist Payment via QR Code in Vietnam: Open the Binance App and tap the  [Pay]  icon Tap on the  [Scan]  icon. Scan the merchant’s QR code ( VietQR, Momo ). Confirm the amount and authorize the payment. After 2FA is completed, the payment is processed immediately. Learn More About Tourist Payment via Binance Pay For More Information: What is Binance Pay How to Send Crypto to Users with Binance Pay How to Receive Crypto Assets with Binance Pay Notes: Binance Pay is currently only available to eligible users in supported countries on Binance.com. To start using Binance Pay, please register on Binance.com and complete  identity verification  for your account. This QR payment feature is exclusively available for  tourists  visiting Vietnam, who have completed Binance’s identity verification process. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-03-02
